scope: Public source view-photo staging for later Insignia DEV configuration QA. Public Shopify/app-proxy config GETs and direct image GETs only; no Superfunny product/config writes, uploads, cart, checkout, or admin actions.
downloadMethod: Fetched each color-specific public app-proxy config referenced in the legacy inventory; checked product/config IDs and matched each view by exact view ID/name; fetched its fresh config-issued media URL in memory. Signed media query strings were not printed or persisted; the manifest stores only HTTPS scheme + host + path with query removed.
limitations: No orientation was inferred from pixels or filename. Exact source view name and perspective are recorded. Calibration values are historical source config, not fresh measurements.
